scenarios.description: Operator places carton onto hand trolley and wheels it gently into designated staging zone.
Operator loses grip on carton at 1.1m height; carton drops with gravitational acceleration and hits floor with severe impact.
Operator tosses carton across 3.5 meters into truck bed without support; ballistic flight trajectory.
Operator drags heavy 45-pound carton across concrete epoxy floor without a trolley.
Operator violently slams carton down onto pallet with excessive kinetic jerk and velocity shock.
Carton staged outside designated yellow perimeter in an active traffic corridor.
Validation clip: Operator handles two cartons; second carton slips and drops during palletizing.
Validation clip: Prolonged continuous dragging of furniture carton across dock floor.
Held-out test clip: Operator tosses fragile package which impacts wall and crashes to floor.
Held-out test clip: Two operators executing controlled, compliant team-lift and pallet staging.
